title: Schema.org BreadcrumbList
description: A BreadcrumbList is an ItemList consisting of a chain of linked Web pages, typically described using at least their URL and their name, and typically ending with the current page.

name.description: The name of the breadcrumb list.

description.description: A description of the breadcrumb list.

numberOfItems.description: The number of items in the breadcrumb list.

ListItem.description: An item in a breadcrumb list.

position.description: The position of an item in a series.

item.description: The item represented by this list item.
